description.de: Versucht einen Befehl erneut, bis er klappt; delay und exponential_backoff steuern die Pausen. Der Platzhalter scheitert zweimal absichtlich und klappt beim dritten Versuch. Ersetze ihn durch einen unzuverlässigen Befehl (Netzwerk, Dienst …).
description.en: Retries a command until it succeeds; delay and exponential_backoff control the pauses. The placeholder fails twice on purpose and succeeds on the third attempt. Replace it with an unreliable command (network, service …).

config.command:
set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
mkdir -p "$D"
echo 0 > "$D/attempts"
echo prepared

set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
N=$(( $(cat "$D/attempts") + 1 ))
echo "$N" > "$D/attempts"
# placeholder - fails twice on purpose, then succeeds
if [ "$N" -lt 3 ]; then echo "attempt $N failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'attempt %s succeeded\n' "$N"

set -eu
set -- {{ workflow_run_id }}
D=/tmp/mysuricates-blueprints/$1
rm -rf "$D"
echo cleaned
